subject: [hw] DONE K02
body:
K02 (/dev/redwood-vcodec hardware part: power, clocks, larbs, register batches, DMA pool, polled IRQs) done, HOST-TESTED ONLY. Nothing here has run on the phone.

Test command and last line:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST K02 PASS 588730/588730 (violations 0)
Two builds: -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all and -O2 without sanitizers; 6.9 s total. The register/SPM model fails the run on any access to a blocks window/gates/LARB while its domain is off/isolated/protected, any write to another blocks LARB port or protection bits, any gate/mux/PWR_CON write outside the block being powered, and any wait that does not end.
Additionally, a local staged kernel compile of the full sweet_touch.c (q10at3 stage + 0298 + IKs 0299 sweet_touch patch + the three .inc + the two frozen headers, CI flags from gpu/tools/xnu_staged_compile.py, -Wall -Wextra -Werror) succeeds; all 162 undefined symbols of the object exist in kernel.development.nord2-metal-q10at3.

Implemented: cdevsw minor 0 /dev/redwood-vcodec 0600; RWVC_INFO; RWVC_POWER with per-file + per-block references, VEN_C1->VEN and VDEC_CORE->VDEC_SOC hidden parent references, the display-parent check, and full bounded SPM sequences for VEN, VEN_CORE1, VDE, VDE2 (power-on/off, protection order, gate and LARB read-backs; every wait bounded); shared VEN with K01 through n2vc_ven_get/put (registered by nord2_vcodec_start); RWVC_REGS (2048 ops, validation, READ/WRITE/MASK/POLL/DELAY, results out, out_done, 2 s batch budget); RWVC_DMA_ALLOC/FREE/RW/FILL (first-fit 86 MiB pool, zero-filled, generation handles, owner/cross-minor-shared access, cache maintenance); RWVC_WAIT_IRQ/RWVC_IRQ_CLEAR polled at 200 us with the Linux ISRs clear writes; everything released on close. IKs relay interface is wired (n2vr_hw registration, server open/close, MSG dispatch, n2vr_dma_allowed).

Files (mine only): gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc (new, 1039 lines, MIT); gpu/hwcodec/kern/VCODEC_HW.md (new, 327 lines, every number with file:line); gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/{run_tests.sh,t_k02.c,STATUS.md}; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/K02/STATUS.md.

Not done / open (full list in STATUS.md):
1. irq_mode 1 (real SPI interrupts) not implemented; polled mode only. The GICv3 registration proposal and open questions for hw-ik are in VCODEC_HW.md section 8.
2. Never run on the phone. VEN is the M1-proven sequence; VDE/VDE2/VEN_CORE1 are transcribed from clk-mt6885-pg.c and model-tested only.
3. [I] vdec_lat_sel may not feed the VDE1 gates (their declared parent is vdec_ck): both vdec muxes are programmed when gated.
4. [I] VENC core 1 IRQ registers 0x1782005c/0x60 (Linux only uses core 0); [I] VDEC_RACING window belongs to VDEC_CORE.
5. Mux parent choice when gated: venc_sel parent 12 / vdec_sel+lat parent 14 (univpll_d4, the phones own venc_sel value); a running mux is never rewritten. The PLL rate is not read.
6. Kernel policy not in the frozen header: 2 s total per RWVC_REGS batch, POLL timeout clamped to 1 s (documented).
7. DMA handle generation is 16 bits: 65536 reuses of one slot could alias a stale handle (documented).
8. hw-ik must add one call, n2vc_relay_closed(p), in n2vr_client_close so a clients DMA buffers are freed at its last close (posted; the kernel links without it).
9. The cdevsw slot table / relay registration are kernel-only and covered by the staged compile, not by the host model.
10. No phone, no publish, no vendor binaries copied.
